verdicts.where: AD-1; Service boundary contracts, Lightning view → Salesforce runtime
verdicts.quote: Use a Lightning Web Component with the `lightning__Tab` target and a CustomTab metadata entry labelled **Grok Bot**. … Session and current effective grants govern each new invocation.

verdicts.where: R-1, State and open gaps; R-4.a
verdicts.quote: Business-record reads, writes, sharing, object CRUD and field access are outside scope. … Do not attach org records, user identifiers, session material or another user's content.
verdicts.missing: The bot excludes records entirely. The specification gives no rule for retrieving records under the asking user's Salesforce sharing permissions.

verdicts.where: AD-1; R-1, State and open gaps
verdicts.quote: a dedicated bot permission set for tab visibility, Apex invocation and external credential principal access … The org owner controls changes.
Only the initiating view and in-flight processing path hold the prompt, reply and related error. … Other users and views cannot retrieve exchanges.
The component calls Apex imperatively on Send. … The server applies its own outbound callout deadline … no independent worker lifecycle.
verdicts.missing: The specification gives no trigger or post-DML callout constraints and selects a foreground request. It provides no asynchronous Apex transaction design.

verdicts.quote: use an enhanced Named Credential for the outbound endpoint with a Custom External Credential … Populate the secret separately from source deployment. … Key values stay out of page data, responses, checked-in metadata and logs.
120-second cumulative callout timeout per Apex transaction … current 10 MB synchronous Apex heap in Winter ’27, with a 6 MB compatibility setting.
verdicts.missing: The per-transaction callout count and CPU-time ceilings are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: A controlled provider can expose exact requests and release held results independently of the bot, without a live account or billed inference.
verdicts.missing: The specification does not require a mock callout implementation for Apex tests or state that those tests cannot call the real provider.

verdicts.quote: use an enhanced Named Credential for the outbound endpoint … Use one non-streaming JSON POST to `https://api.x.ai/v1/responses` per admitted send. … Missing setup and credential, entitlement or model rejection produce setup/access feedback.

verdicts.where: AD-3; Service boundary contracts, Lightning view → Salesforce runtime
verdicts.quote: Apply a result only to its matching live attempt before the UI deadline. … Single terminal invocation result. … There is no durable job or resumed delivery.
verdicts.missing: The view receives the foreground invocation's result. No mechanism delivers a reply from independently running asynchronous work.

verdicts.quote: Missing setup and credential, entitlement or model rejection produce setup/access feedback. HTTP 429 gives rate-limit feedback and guidance to try later. Timeout, transport failure and upstream 5xx give temporary-failure feedback.
verdicts.missing: Timeout and upstream 5xx share one user-visible outcome. The remaining 4xx refusals have no general user-visible mapping.

verdicts.quote: Another explicit Send permits retry after the condition clears. … HTTP 429 gives rate-limit feedback and guidance to try later. … No automatic retry, queue or poll.

Timeout, transport failure and upstream 5xx give temporary-failure feedback. Non-final or incomplete success-status responses, malformed body, empty reply or other unexpected results give reply-unavailable feedback. Failures show no answer or raw upstream error.

verdicts.where: R-4.c; R-4, State and open gaps
verdicts.quote: Clear or view termination removes the transient exchange. … Clear has no effect on provider audit copies. … xAI documents default audit retention of 30 days followed by deletion
verdicts.missing: The text specifies local clearing and a provider default. It leaves the applicable provider retention term open and gives no account-deletion rule for outstanding data.

verdicts.quote: instruct users to use synthetic, non-sensitive content. Pass the prompt and necessary inference parameters only. … Do not attach org records, user identifiers, session material or another user's content. … User-typed prompt content is sent as entered.

verdicts.where: R-2.c; R-2, State and open gaps
verdicts.quote: The next outbound request excludes the previous prompt, reply and response ID. … the implementation owner must establish the maximum accepted UTF-8 prompt bytes
verdicts.missing: Each send omits all history. No size threshold or trimming or summarization policy is specified for a growing conversation.

verdicts.quote: A new view starts empty. … Missing, empty, whitespace-only or over-limit input gets input-specific feedback and produces zero outbound requests. … At the supported maximum, a nonblank prompt is accepted. Above it, reject without truncation.
verdicts.missing: The maximum accepted prompt size and the response/output budget are unresolved, so the concrete length boundaries cannot be implemented from the text alone.

verdicts.quote: The org owner can withdraw bot access and remove only feature-owned resources to restore prior org configuration and availability. … Supply the configured Grok model and a single user input.
verdicts.missing: The specification leaves administrator access to change the model and inspect failed requests undefined.

verdicts.quote: Use the selected non-production development org. … Populate the secret separately from source deployment.
verdicts.missing: The specification does not define a scratch-org or sandbox release path, per-environment configuration and credentials, or the production code-coverage requirement.

verdicts.quote: After admission, show **Waiting for Grok** and the submitted prompt. … The implementation owner must select a finite request deadline
verdicts.missing: No numerical answer-latency target or end-to-end deadline is set.

verdicts.quote: a separate status area announcing pending and terminal changes. … rounded tonal surfaces … A new view starts empty. … A refusal expressed as ordinary assistant text is shown. … Failures show no answer

verdicts.where: R-1, Basis and delta; R-1, State and open gaps; AD-2
verdicts.quote: Preserve unrelated navigation, settings, permissions and records. … Business-record reads, writes, sharing, object CRUD and field access are outside scope. … The component calls Apex imperatively on Send.
